City of Norwalk
  AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  FEBRUARY 2, 2021
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20, N-29-20, AND N-35-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO BE
  VIDEOCONFERENCED WITHOUT PROVIDING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS
DURING A MEETING, EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR CALL (669) 900-
 6833; MEETING ID: 709 573 2685; PASSCODE: 784059 DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM
  OR UNDER ORAL COMMUNICATIONS. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR
  CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-
  agendas-393.
  4:45 PM
  VIDEOCONFERENCE
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  STUDY SESSION MEETING – 5:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS
 CLOSED SESSION

  I.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957(a):
  THREAT TO PUBLIC SERVICES OR FACILITIES – Consultation with the City Manager, Los Angeles
  County Sheriff representative, and other related City officials.

  II.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - ANTICIPATED LITIGATION  PURSUANT  TO
  GOVERNMENT CODE §54956.9(d)(4): initiation of litigation in one case.

RECESS

  REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

INVOCATION
  Grissel Chavez
  Director of Public Safety

FLAG SALUTE
  Glen Kau
  Director of Public Services/City Engineer

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS - None

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS
  COVID-19 Update.

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meetings of
  January 13 and 19, 2021. 825-04

  Minutes Paperclip icon

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period December 27, 2020 –
  January 9, 2021, in the total amount of $886,174.86. 630

  Report Paperclip icon

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period
  January 13, 2021 through January 27, 2021, in the total amount of $1,965,964.20. 640

  Report Paperclip icon

  4.  PROJECT NO. 7858 – ACCEPT WORK - CITY HALL REMODEL PROJECT FOR COMMUNITY
  DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT AND ENGINEERING DIVISON - Staff recommends City Council
   accept the work of MTL Construction Services, Inc. of Anaheim, for the construction of offices in the
  Community Development Department and Engineering Division and an exterior meeting room, in the
  amount of $340,896.30; and authorize the City Manager to sign the Certificate of Final Completion and
  Acceptance form. 1005-04-7858

  Report Paperclip icon

APPOINTMENTS

  5.  ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report Paperclip icon

PUBLIC HEARING

  6.  ORDINANCE NO. 21-1722 - NORWALK MUNICIPAL CODE RECODIFICATION – Staff recommends
  City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 21-1722, AN ORDINANCE OF THE
  CITY OF NORWALK, CALIFORNIA ADOPTING BY REFERENCE THE NORWALK MUNICIPAL
  CODE, (WHICH CODE CONSISTS OF TITLES 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, AND 18 OF
  THE NORWALK MUNICIPAL CODE ON FILE IN THE OFFICE OF THE NORWALK CITY CLERK),
  WHICH CODE ADOPTS THE FOLLOWING SECONDARY CODES BY REFERENCE: DIVISION 1,
  HEALTH CODE, OF TITLE 11 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE; DIVISION 1, PUBLIC
  HEALTH LICENSES, OF TITLE 8 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE; THE LOS ANGELES
  COUNTY VEHICLES AND TRAFFIC CODE (THE COUNTY TRAFFIC ORDINANCE) AS ADOPTED,
  AMENDED AND IN EFFECT ON FEBRUARY 13, 1981; THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE, TITLE
  32, 2002 FIRE CODE; DIVISION 2, SANITARY SEWERS AND INDUSTRIAL WASTE, OF TITLE 20
  OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE; PART 2 OF TITLE 24 OF THE CALIFORNIA CODE OF
  REGULATIONS, INCLUDING THE APPENDICES, COMPRISING THE 2019 CALIFORNIA BUILDING
  CODE; PART 5 OF TITLE 24 OF THE CALIFORNIA CODE OF REGULATIONS, INCLUDING THE
  APPENDICES, COMPRISING THE 2019 CALIFORNIA PLUMBING CODE; PART 3 OF TITLE 24 OF
  THE CALIFORNIA CODE OF REGULATIONS, INCLUDING THE APPENDICES COMPRISING THE
  2019 CALIFORNIA ELECTRICAL CODE; PART 4 OF TITLE 24 OF THE CALIFORNIA CODE OF
  REGULATIONS, INCLUDING THE APPENDICES, COMPRISING THE 2019 CALIFORNIA
  MECHANICAL CODE; AND PART 10 OF TITLE 24 OF THE CALIFORNIA CODE OF REGULATIONS,
  COMPRISING APPENDIX 1 OF THE 2019 CALIFORNIA CODE FOR BUILDING CONSERVATION.
  860

  Report Paperclip icon

  7.  PROJECT NO. 7235 - AGREEMENT AMENDMENT NO. 1 – DESIGN SERVICES - RESOLUTION NO.
  21-03 – BUDGET AMENDMENT - Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 21-03, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE PROPOSITION C FUNDS TO PROJECT NO. 7235 –
  IMPERIAL HIGHWAY INTELLIGENT TRANSPORTATION SYSTEM (ITS) IMPROVEMENTS, in
  the amount of $166,000; and

  b.  approve Amendment No. 1 to the agreement with Advantec Consulting Engineers to provide
  additional design services and additional compensation in the amount of $157,180; and authorize
  the City Manager to execute the amendment, and any additional amendments provided there is
  funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 1005-04-7235

  Report Paperclip icon

REPORTS

  8.  AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO THE CRISIS COMMUNICATION SERVICES AGREEMENT – Staff
  recommends City Council approve Amendment No. 2 to the crisis communication consulting services
  agreement with Merino, Barajas & Associates, Inc. extending the term through June 30, 2021 in an
  amount not to exceed $47,500; and authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 2 on behalf
  of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 710-07

  Report Paperclip icon
   9.  AGREEMENT - ADVANCED RESERVATION DIAL-A-RIDE / SUBSCRIPTION SERVICE - Staff
  recommends City Council approve the agreement with First Transit, Inc. in an amount of $1,329,125 for
  the Advanced Reservation Dial-A-Ride / Subscription Service program for the period of April 1, 2021
  through June 30, 2023, with an option to extend annually for two (2) additional one (1) year periods
  from July 1 through June 30 of each year thereafter for a total contract value of $2,598,492; and
  authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any amendments, provided there is funding
  in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 1120-07

  Report Paperclip icon

  10. EMERGENCY AGREEMENT – PARATRANSIT USER SIDE SUBSIDY TRANSPORTATION
  PROGRAM - Staff recommends City Council approve by a 4/5 vote, the emergency contract between
  the City of Norwalk and First Transit, Inc. in partnership with Lyft to provide Paratransit User Side
  Subsidy Transportation services, for a period of six months; effective, March 1, 2021 through August
  31, 2021, in the amount of $32,502; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any
  amendments provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the
  City Attorney. 1120-07

  Report Paperclip icon

  11. SIXTH (6th) CYCLE HOUSING ELEMENT UPDATE - Staff recommends City Council receive and file
  this report.

  Report Paperclip icon

  12. CORONAVIRUS PANDEMIC – FEBRUARY EMERGENCY OPERATIONS CENTER UPDATE –
  Receive and file. 710-07

  Report Paperclip icon

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated January 29, 2021.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
